title: File:CONFORMAL ROBOTIC GRIPPER- JOHN VRANISH - DPLA - a8145cfde8f4ec0b79f5695401637bd6.jpg
desc: The original finding aid described this as: Description: PHOTOGRAPHS OF JOHN VRANISH AND CONFORMAL ROBOTIC GRIPPER.
